_readme: Known, intended exceptions to the UI check, per check: CSS selectors whose elements (and everything in them) are skipped. Each needs a reason. Prefer data-ui-check-allow="<check>" on the element itself.

reasons..ov-card__art: stretched: a card picture keeps the card shape even when it is the empty New character tile
reasons..ov-rail__portrait-empty: stretched: the empty portrait keeps the size of the picture it stands in for
